title: Urban Company raises Rs 2,500 crore via QIP
summary: Urban Company raises 2,500 crore rupees through a qualified institutional placement round
detailed: The company, which was adjudged Startup of the Year at the ET Startup Awards 2025, said in its preliminary placement document that it plans to allocate Rs 600 crore from the fresh capital raise towards its InstaHelp business which operates in the high cash burn 10-minute house help space.
